mapper.sql: A.CKUP_RCD_ATCH_SN , A.CKUP_RCD_SN , A.ATCH_TYPE_CD , T.COM_CD_NM AS ATCH_TYPE_CD_NM , A.IMG_KND_CD , K.COM_CD_NM AS IMG_KND_CD_NM , A.SHT_REGN_CD , R.COM_CD_NM AS SHT_REGN_CD_NM , F.ORGNL_FILE_NM , F.FILE_EXTN_CD , A.REG_DT
mapper.select:
/* 검진기록 첨부 단건 조회 */ SELECT
FROM CKUP_RCD_ATCH A JOIN ATCH_FILE F ON F.ATCH_FILE_SN = A.ATCH_FILE_SN LEFT JOIN COM_CD T ON T.COM_CD = A.ATCH_TYPE_CD AND T.COM_CD_PRNT_SN IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN COM_CD K ON K.COM_CD = A.IMG_KND_CD AND K.COM_CD_PRNT_SN IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN COM_CD R ON R.COM_CD = A.SHT_REGN_CD AND R.COM_CD_PRNT_SN IS NOT NULL WHERE A.CKUP_RCD_ATCH_SN = #{ckupRcdAtchSn} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* 검진기록 첨부 조회 */ SELECT CKUP_RCD_ATCH_SN , CKUP_RCD_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , ATCH_TYPE_CD , IMG_KND_CD , SHT_REGN_CD , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , RGTR_ID , MDFR_ID FROM CKUP_RCD_ATCH WHERE CKUP_RCD_ATCH_SN = #{ckupRcdAtchSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: /* 반려동물의 검진기록 첨부 전체 삭제 (반려동물 삭제, 연결 일정 삭제 여부와 무관) */ UPDATE CKUP_RCD_ATCH A JOIN CKUP_RCD C ON C.CKUP_RCD_SN = A.CKUP_RCD_SN JOIN SCHDL S ON S.SCHDL_SN = C.SCHDL_SN SET A.DEL_YN = 'Y' , A.MDFR_ID = #{actorId} , A.MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE S.PET_SN = #{petSn} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
